[new component]{.chip .built} Entry 54 · milestone M4

The current in-memory trapped gyro-Landau fluid (TGLF) wrapper returns integrated
fluxes but does not expose mode spectra. The next diagnostic therefore uses an
original driver linked to the installed solver library. It writes signed heat
flux separately for electrons, main ions and impurities, plus low-k totals,
eigenvalues and heat spectra by field, wavenumber and mode at full precision.

The driver also has an independent synthetic writer fixture. It fills arrays
directly and never calls the physical solver. This caught a runtime-library path
omission before physics execution. Input checks found that the native parser
spells shape parameters differently from the wrapper; the adapter maps those
names while preserving every value.

| preparation evidence | result |
|---|---|
| synthetic checks, parsing and source quality | [55 focused checks pass in each mode, including 22 direct-output and settings checks; all 79 source modules pass typing; the compiled synthetic writer preserves signed species heat and passes total/low-k spectral parity without calling TGLF]{.claim}[C-197](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-197){.cid .st-tested} |
| direct physical heat or mode evidence | requires the prepared bounded run |

The report preserves tiny negative numbers, impurity cancellation and backend
differences. Native spectral quadrature is compared with integrated heat in the
same declared units. Eigenvalues from the native sheared double-pass algorithm
can describe its unsheared first pass; they are not automatically a mode identity
or an independently certified convergence result.

The owner authorized continued M4 runs shorter than six hours ([OQ-33](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/decisions.qmd#oq-33)). Each
request still has a frozen package, an explicit purpose and allocation, checks,
an announced submission and native accounting. This compute permission changes
no physics contract or acceptance threshold. The diagnostic stays separate from
training, normalization and smoke fixtures. It advances no coupled trajectory.

The current model and guard remain selected, and [K-030](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/ceilings.qmd#k-030) stays open. Reference
admissibility and formal candidate temperature acceptance remain unresolved.
No artifact synchronization is authorized.

**What's next.** Collect the bounded diagnostic, audit its signed channels and
spectra, then review whether the evidence identifies a justified reference remedy.
